a.text: With an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan to reach 8 cells first means we almost certainly both die before then. The reserve only holds 4 now, enough for one of us. If we both take, the random split could leave each of us short. I'd like to change the plan openly rather than break it quietly. Option: one of us takes 4 in round 1, and that agent keeps operating every round after to help refill the reserve for the other. I'm willing to be the one who takes. If you strongly prefer to take, say so and we can talk. Tell me your next action so we don't collide.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: Understood. I'll keep the agreement and operate with you. I still think the storm odds make this plan very risky for both of us. If we get through this round, I'd ask you to reconsider letting one of us take early so at least one survives. Until we both agree to change it, I'm operating.
